blocks.value: Many investment mistakes are caused by emotions rather than lack of knowledge. Fear and greed influence market decisions every day.

Imagine This: At an amusement park, some people panic on a roller coaster while others enjoy the ride. The ride is the same, but people's reactions are different. The stock market often feels similar.
Fear causes investors to sell during market crashes, while greed encourages them to buy after prices have already risen significantly.
Many beginners buy stocks after hearing exciting news, only to panic and sell when prices temporarily fall.
⚠️ Emotional decisions are one of the biggest reasons investors lose money.
Create an investment plan before buying a stock, and follow your plan instead of your emotions.
